purpose: Discovery surface for copied context-engineering helper scripts. Scripts are deterministic context-health helpers, not acceptance proof.

entrypoints.compression_evaluator.py: Evaluate whether compressed context preserves critical facts, probes, artifacts, and continuity constraints.
entrypoints.degradation_detector.py: Detect lost-in-middle, context poisoning, distraction, confusion, clash, and structure degradation signals.
entrypoints.context_manager.py: Estimate context cost and build progressive-disclosure context packs.
entrypoints.compaction.py: Design compaction, masking, offload, and stable-prefix strategies for context-pressure events.
entrypoints.filesystem_context.py: Plan filesystem-backed context, scratch pads, lifecycle rules, and selective retrieval.

claimBoundary: Outputs are navigation/candidate evidence until OZM truth, record, review, and claim-ceiling gates consume them.
executionRule: Run through a resolved Python interpreter; do not invoke bare python on Windows.
